text:
sophie: @mariana flagged — ACME reported a regression after the recent canary. They say invoice IDs are showing as 'N/A' and 95th latency spiked. Can you triage?
acme-support: We're seeing this in production since ~08:50 UTC. Example response: 'invoice_id: N/A' where it used to be numeric. No API errors, request succeeded. Using model redwood-2b pinned v3 -> then canary to v4 today. Also noticed p95 jump from 180ms to ~420ms.
ajay: Oncall here, looking. Can you paste a redacted request payload + headers? Any auth/billing errors?
acme-support: Redacted payload pasted: {"prompt":"Extract invoice id","text":"Invoice 82471 for $1,200" ,"model":"redwood-2b"}. No 4xx/5xx, no auth issues.
mariana: Deployment note: we started canary for redwood-2b v4 at 08:41:12 UTC (5% traffic). Could be behavior change.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: redwood-2b v4 -> 08:41:12 UTC, canary-group: general-5pct.
ajay: Inspecting serving logs — I see tokenization fallback + kernel selection warnings around 08:48 that forced a quantized execution path for sequences >512. That path treats unknown numeric patterns differently, returning placeholder 'N/A' in some prompt templates. Opening INF-3421.
sophie: Can you repro locally with v4 and a redacted example?
ajay: Repro'd on dev: with redwood-2b:v4 the extractor returns 'N/A' when the quantized kernel path triggers. v3 returns numeric ids as expected.
mariana: Suggested mitigations: 1) Rollback canary for affected customers (start with ACME). 2) Short-term prompt shim: post-process 'N/A' -> try regex extraction to restore numeric id when possible. 3) Block v4 canary until fix.
ajay: Initiating targeted rollback for ACME account and Dedicated pools serving them.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete for canary group: acme-account, dedicated-pool-3 at 09:12:05 UTC.
acme-support: Confirming — numeric ids returned again at 09:13 UTC. Latency improved but p95 still ~260ms (down from 420).
ajay: Latency residual due to autoscaler thrash after rollback; adjusting target utilization and warming pools — expect stabilization in 10-15m.
sophie: I'll send customer comms now: apology, rollback summary, short-term guidance (prompt shim + monitoring), ETA for permanent fix after INF-3421 triage.
mariana: Internal action items: assign INF-3421 to runtime team, add quantization edge-case tests to canary QA, review kernel selection heuristics.
sophie: Draft customer message: "We observed an unintentional behavior change after today's canary of redwood-2b v4 that affected invoice id extraction for some inputs. We rolled back the canary for your account and recommend a short-term post-processing rule (regex) while we fix the root cause. We'll follow up with RCA and timeline." Send for review?
acme-support: That works — thanks for quick response. Please include brief note on latency remediation.
ajay: Noted. Will follow up if we see recurrence or other fallout.
mariana: Will schedule postmortem and include canary QA improvements.
sophie: Sending update to ACME now, will post a summary in #customer-success-updates when RCA is ready. :white_check_mark:
